_comment: Authored analysis: ownership, lifecycle, refcount and locking judgements that no composer can derive, keyed to the C entities they describe. The structural half of each record (field layout, signatures, footprints, casts) is composed from the CodeQL tables on demand and merged in at read time, so a re-extract rewrites nothing here. Written only by `crustify-oracle <target> query {types,symbols} --update`; read through crustify.manifests. Hand-edit at your own risk: `--update` validates a submission against the composed skeleton (unknown field, wrong kind, ptr-invariant violation) and this file does not.

types.name: git_annotated_commit
types._comment_agent: The public API keeps git_annotated_commit opaque. Internal inspection shows the discriminant selects two ownership variants: real commits own commit/tree and duplicated strings; virtual commits own index and the parents buffer. Pointer members are nullable across the union-like variants and all are released by git_annotated_commit_free.

ptr.note: A duplicated git_commit owned by the real variant and released with git_commit_free; absent for virtual commits.
A git__strdup allocation for real commits and null for virtual commits, released by git__free.
Owned only by the virtual variant and released with git_index_free; absent for real commits.
Optional git__strdup allocation for reference/fetch-head commits, released by git__free.
Optional git__strdup allocation for fetch-head commits, released by git__free.
Lazily populated for a real annotated commit by git_commit_tree and released with git_tree_free; absent for virtual commits.

types.name: git_apply_location_t
types._comment_agent: git_apply_location_t is a fieldless public enum with three contiguous values (WORKDIR=0, INDEX=1, BOTH=2) declared in include/git2/apply.h. It is passed by value to git_apply and carries no pointer, lifecycle, refcount, or locking semantics.

types.name: git_attr_value_t
types._comment_agent: git_attr_value_t is a fieldless enum with no pointer, lifecycle, refcount, or locking semantics.

types.name: git_blame
types._comment_agent: The public API exposes git_blame only as an opaque, uniquely owned result released by git_blame_free. Internally it owns its duplicated path, optional mailmap and blob, hunk/path vectors, and counted line/index buffers; it borrows the repository. final, ent, final_buf, and current_hunk are transient aliases or work-state pointers and are not published as fields.

ptr.note: Temporary mutable cursor into an owned hunk stored by the hunks vector during git_blame_buffer. It is never independently released.
Head of the mutable, owned scoreboard-entry list during blame_internal. Every entry is released on that routine's success and error exits; the stale field is not subsequently used or published.

Transient alias to the commit adopted by a git_blame__origin. Entry cleanup releases the origin (and commit) before blame_internal returns, so this field is thereafter stale and is never exposed or dereferenced.
Owned blob lookup result, optionally absent during partial construction, released by git_blame_free.
Counted read-only bytes returned by git_blob_rawcontent and kept alive by final_blob; buffer-derived blame objects leave this NULL.
Owned growable array of line-start offsets; storage is allocated by index_blob_lines and cleared by git_blame_free.
Owned growable array of git_blame_line values; elements are initialized by index_blob_lines and storage is cleared by git_blame_free.
Optional mailmap created when GIT_BLAME_USE_MAILMAP is set and released by git_blame_free.
Owned git__strdup path, released by git_blame_free. It may be NULL while git_blame__alloc unwinds a partial construction.
Borrowed repository retained for blame computation and for constructing a derived buffer blame. The caller must keep it alive; libgit2 operations may mutate repository-owned internal state.

types.name: git_blame_options
types._comment_agent: All published fields are by-value scalars or embedded git_oid values; the options struct owns no pointer fields and has no lifecycle primitive.

types.name: git_blob
types._comment_agent: The data union is discriminated by raw: either an owned reference-counted ODB object or a borrowed immutable byte buffer.

ptr.note: When raw is clear, git_blob__parse stores a non-null git_odb_object after taking a cache reference; git_blob__free releases that reference. Refcount operations mutate the pointee.
When raw is set, this is a caller-owned byte buffer stored by git_blob__parse_raw with data.raw.size; the blob neither copies nor frees it. Empty input may use null.

types.name: git_branch_iterator
types._comment_agent: Public opaque iterator. Its allocation is uniquely owned and released by git_branch_iterator_free; no fields are published.

types.name: git_branch_t
types._comment_agent: Closed public branch-kind enum with LOCAL and REMOTE values plus the ALL bitwise filter value; it has no pointer or lifecycle fields.

types.name: git_buf
types._comment_agent: Public git_buf owns a counted mutable byte allocation through ptr, except for its NULL initial state and the static empty sentinel. reserved is allocation capacity and size is initialized payload length.

ptr.note: Counted mutable byte buffer owned by git_buf when allocated; empty sanitized buffers may instead point at the static git_str__initstr sentinel. NULL is valid in GIT_BUF_INIT. The size excludes a guaranteed trailing NUL, but interior NUL bytes are allowed, so this is modeled as an array rather than a string. git_buf_dispose handles the owned-vs-static runtime gate.

types.name: git_cached_obj
types._comment_agent: git_cached_obj is the common prefix of git_object and git_odb_object. Its refcount field is atomically incremented/decremented by git_cached_obj_incref/decref; the remaining fields are initialized before cache publication and contain no pointers.

types.name: git_cert
types._comment_agent: Public git_cert is a one-field by-value base record. cert_type is a scalar git_cert_t discriminant initialized by the concrete certificate producer and thereafter read through public callbacks; the type has no pointer fields, refcount, or independent lifecycle operation.

types.name: git_clone_local_t
types._comment_agent: Closed public C enum with four scalar values and no ownership-bearing fields.

types.name: git_commit
types._comment_agent: The public API keeps git_commit opaque. Internally, its reference-counted git_object base ultimately disposes all pointer fields: signatures and strings are individually owned, and parent_ids owns a resizable git_oid buffer. Several members are null during quick/partial parsing, message_encoding and body are optional, and summary/body are populated lazily.

ptr.note: Owned git_signature storage allocated and filled during full parsing, absent during quick parsing or failed partial construction, and released by git_signature_free.
Optional lazily allocated body string owned by the commit and released by git__free; remains null when the message has no body.
Owned git_signature storage allocated and filled by commit_parse, then released by git_signature_free; null is tolerated during failed partial construction.
Optional encoding-header copy allocated by parsing, owned by the commit, and released by git__free.
Owned resizable array of inline git_oid values; the pointer may be null for zeroed/cleared or failed storage and git_array_clear releases it.
Owned header copy for fully parsed commits; null in quick or partial parses and released by git__free.
Owned NUL-terminated message copy for fully parsed commits; null in quick or partial parses and released by git__free.
Optional lazily allocated summary string owned by the commit and released by git__free.

types.name: git_config
types._comment_agent: git_config is refcounted through rc: git_config_new initializes one count, repository storage increments it, and git_config_free decrements it before releasing the object.

types.name: git_config_entry
types._comment_agent: git_config_entry is the public prefix of a dynamically finalized git_config_backend_entry. Its four const char pointers are owned collectively by the concrete backend entry (direct allocations or storage held by its retained config-list); git_config_entry_free invokes the concrete finalizer. The strings remain live for the entry owner's lifetime and are read-only through the published API.

ptr.note: Required interned NUL-terminated backend kind held by the retained config-list and released indirectly by the entry finalizer.
Required normalized NUL-terminated name, retained by the concrete backend entry and released indirectly by its finalizer.
Optional interned NUL-terminated origin path held by the retained config-list and released indirectly by the entry finalizer.
Optional literal NUL-terminated value; valueless configuration entries use NULL. Storage is released indirectly by the concrete entry finalizer.

types.name: git_credential
types._comment_agent: git_credential is a polymorphic public base header. Every fully constructed credential installs a non-null immutable finalizer callback with static code lifetime; the callback frees the concrete allocation and any secret-bearing fields. credtype is a by-value bit tag.

ptr.note: Required concrete finalizer callback installed by every successful credential constructor. The code pointer is static and git_credential_free invokes it exactly once for an owned credential.

types.name: git_describe_format_options
types._comment_agent: Public format options are caller-owned by value and have no lifecycle operation. dirty_suffix is an optional borrowed const C string read synchronously by git_describe__format.

ptr.note: The options struct only borrows this optional NUL-terminated suffix. git_describe__format copies the options by value and reads the string during the formatting call; no path stores, mutates, clones, or frees it. The caller must keep the suffix alive while the options may be used.

types.name: git_describe_options
types._comment_agent: The options struct owns no pointee storage. pattern is an optional borrowed input string whose caller must keep it valid through each describe operation.

ptr.note: Optional caller-owned NUL-terminated match pattern; libgit2 only reads it during describe calls and neither stores a copy nor frees it.

types.name: git_describe_result
types._comment_agent: A describe result owns its optional name/tag variant and borrows its repository. Its public destructor releases the owned variant and result storage but not the repository.

ptr.note: Deep-duplicated exact-match commit_name owned by the result; formatting may lazily populate its tag, and result_free releases its tag, path, and allocation.
Borrowed from the repository owning the input object (or passed to workdir); format uses it but result_free does not release it, so the repository must outlive result use.
Deep-duplicated possible_tag owned by the result; formatting may mutate the nested commit_name, and result_free releases the complete nested allocation.

types.name: git_diff
types._comment_agent: git_diff is publicly opaque but internally refcounted. Its repository slot is a nullable non-owning pointer (parsed diffs leave it null; generated diffs retain a repository borrow). All callback slots are non-owning addresses of static libgit2 functions and are initialized for every fully constructed generated or parsed diff.

ptr.note: Initialized to a static case-sensitive or case-insensitive comparison routine.
Initialized to the generated- or parsed-diff static destructor before publication.
Initialized to the generated- or parsed-diff static patch factory before publication.
Initialized to a static case-sensitive or case-insensitive prefix routine.
Generated diffs borrow their repository and use it for later diff/patch operations; parsed diffs store null. The diff destructor does not release the repository.
Initialized to a static libgit2 comparison routine for every fully constructed diff.
Initialized to a static libgit2 comparison routine for every fully constructed diff.

types.name: git_diff_binary_file
types._comment_agent: The data member is a nullable counted byte allocation. Generation and parsing allocate it through libgit2's configured allocator, and the enclosing patch (or the temporary callback producer) releases it with git__free. Callback consumers borrow the complete git_diff_binary_file and only read its bytes.

ptr.note: Owns datalen initialized deflated bytes allocated through libgit2; null is used when no binary data is present. The containing patch or temporary producer frees the allocation with git__free.

types.name: git_diff_file
types._comment_agent: The path is a nullable borrowed NUL-terminated string. Generated diffs point into their owning diff pool; parsed patches point into allocations owned by the enclosing patch, sometimes at an interior offset. The git_diff_file header never independently releases the path.

ptr.note: Borrows a NUL-terminated path kept alive by the enclosing diff or patch. It may be null for an absent/partially initialized side and can point into another owning allocation.

types.name: git_diff_line
types._comment_agent: Inspected every content/content_len assignment, read, and release path. Ownership is runtime-conditional at the containing patch implementation level, so the wrapper exposes a borrowed counted view and does not assume standalone ownership.

ptr.note: Counted, non-NUL-terminated bytes. Parsed-patch lines own separately allocated content which patch_parsed__free releases; generated, apply, print, and xdiff lines borrow parent or callback backing storage. Public observations bind the bytes to the line/containing patch lifetime. Zero-initialized and empty construction paths permit NULL with length zero; the const pointer is never written through.

types.name: git_diff_stats
types._comment_agent: The public type is opaque. Its successful constructor owns one refcounted git_diff handle and one files_changed-length statistics buffer; its public destructor releases both before freeing the header.

ptr.note: git_diff_get_stats stores a non-null git_diff, increments its reference count, and git_diff_stats_free releases that owned count with git_diff_free.

git_diff_get_stats allocates a mutable diff_file_stats array whose element count is files_changed; construction fails if allocation returns null, and git_diff_stats_free releases the buffer with git__free.

types.name: git_error
types._comment_agent: git_error itself has no unconditional lifecycle contract: git_error_last returns libgit2-managed TLS/static storage, while internal git_error_save may allocate a separately freed snapshot. The message field therefore has runtime-conditional owned/borrowed string storage.

ptr.note: Runtime-conditional storage: git_error_save duplicates and owns the NUL-terminated message, the TLS error borrows its containing threadstate's git_str buffer, and static sentinel errors borrow string literals. git_error_free releases only saved non-static objects. Public git_error_last exposes a const borrowed view. NULL is accepted by set_error/restore and free, though ordinary published errors use non-null messages.

types.name: git_index
types._comment_agent: git_index is publicly opaque but internally refcounted. tree points into the sibling tree_pool arena; comparator slots always borrow static functions; index_file_path owns an optional strdup allocation.

ptr.note: Initialized to a static strcmp-style comparator.
Initialized to one of the static index-entry search functions.
Initialized to one of the static path-search functions.
Optional git__strdup result; index_free releases it with git__free.
Initialized to one of the static case-sensitive/case-insensitive comparator functions.
Cache nodes are allocated in tree_pool; clearing that sibling pool invalidates the pointer, which is repeatedly nulled and rebuilt.

types.name: git_index_conflict_iterator
types._comment_agent: The conflict iterator exclusively owns only its allocation and borrows the external index stored in `index`.

ptr.note: The constructor stores its required index argument without retaining it; iteration reads and may sort the index entries, and the public contract forbids modification while iterating, so the index must outlive the iterator.

types.name: git_index_entry
types._comment_agent: Inspected all path field touchers and index_entry_create/dup/free. The pointer's concrete backing differs between caller-built input values and index-owned returned entries, so the uniform public field contract is a nullable immutable borrowed C string whose actual keeper must outlive every use of the enclosing entry.

ptr.note: The public struct is usable as caller-owned by-value input: git_index_add copies the path before returning, so such a path is externally borrowed. Entries stored by an index instead point into trailing storage in entry_internal and remain valid only with that containing entry/index. The field never independently owns or frees the string; null is a valid zero-initialized pre-construction state.

types.name: git_indexer
types._comment_agent: The public API treats git_indexer as opaque. Its retained ODB and callback state are borrowed, while its internal pack singleton is owned and released by git_indexer_free.

ptr.note: Copied from git_indexer_options without an up-ref and never released by git_indexer_free; callers keep the ODB alive through the indexer's use. Read operations receive the non-const ODB handle and may mutate its internal state.

git_packfile_alloc initializes this owned singleton; construction begins with NULL and git_indexer_free releases a successfully constructed pack with git_packfile_free. Indexing mutates the pack and mapped-window state.
Optional callback copied from the options and invoked but never freed or modified; its validity must cover indexer operations and is coupled to progress_payload.
Opaque optional application payload copied from the options and passed to progress_cb without transfer or release; the callback may mutate the pointee and the caller must keep it alive.

types.name: git_iterator
types._comment_agent: git_iterator is an opaque public note-iterator alias with uniquely owned allocation. Internally, start/end are optional duplicated ranges owned by the iterator; cb and comparison callbacks borrow static function tables/functions; repo and index are optional mutable borrowed dependencies that must remain alive while variants use them.

ptr.note: Points to the static callback table selected by the concrete iterator constructor; every fully constructed iterator initializes it.
Optional git__strdup range endpoint owned by the iterator and released by git_iterator_free.
Static case-sensitive or case-insensitive index-entry search function selected during initialization.
Optional borrowed index retained by index/workdir variants and used when releasing snapshots; git_iterator_free does not release the index itself.
Static prefix comparison function selected during initialization.
Optional borrowed repository used by tree/workdir variants; the iterator does not release it, and libgit2 operations may mutate repository internals.
Optional git__strdup range start owned by the iterator and released by git_iterator_free.
Static string comparison function selected during initialization.
Static bounded string comparison function selected during initialization.

types.name: git_merge_file_input
types._comment_agent: git_merge_file_input is a non-owning by-value descriptor. Both pointer fields borrow external storage for the duration of any merge operation; the header has no disposer or cloner.

ptr.note: Optional borrowed NUL-terminated file name. Public callers supply it; merge code reads it and may temporarily substitute a static default, but never frees or mutates it.
Borrowed byte span counted by size. It may contain interior NUL bytes; merge routines only read it and never free it. Null is the initialized empty representation.

types.name: git_merge_file_options
types._comment_agent: The three optional labels are shallow-copied with the options and never released by it; every consumer treats them as read-only NUL-terminated strings. Callers must keep non-null labels alive through all uses.

ptr.note: Optional caller-owned NUL-terminated label; libgit2 only reads it while consuming the options value.
Optional caller-owned NUL-terminated label; libgit2 only reads it while consuming the options value.
Optional caller-owned NUL-terminated label; libgit2 only reads it while consuming the options value.

types.name: git_merge_file_result
types._comment_agent: The public result is an inline/by-value header that owns its optional path and counted content allocations; its public free routine disposes those fields without freeing the header.

ptr.note: git_merge_file_result producers duplicate the selected path with git__strdup; git_merge_file_result_free releases it with git__free. A filename conflict may leave it null.
The result owns len bytes produced by xdl_merge or git__malloc; git_merge_file_result_free releases the allocation with git__free. Empty or unmerged results may use null.

types.name: git_message_trailer
types._comment_agent: git_message_trailers stores both pointers into the array-owned extracted trailer block; git_message_trailer_array_free releases that block and the trailer array together.

ptr.note: NUL-terminated key points into the owning git_message_trailer_array's _trailer_block and remains live only while that array remains live.
NUL-terminated value points into the owning git_message_trailer_array's _trailer_block and remains live only while that array remains live.

types.name: git_message_trailer_array
types._comment_agent: git_message_trailers transfers two coordinated allocations into the value: trailers owns count by-value descriptors whose key/value pointers borrow the separately owned _trailer_block. The public disposer frees both fields but retains the caller's header.

ptr.note: Private uniquely owned NUL-terminated allocation produced by extract_trailer_block; trailer key/value pointers borrow subranges of it, and git_message_trailer_array_free releases it.
Unique git-array allocation containing count initialized git_message_trailer values; elements borrow their strings from _trailer_block, and the array disposer releases the allocation.

types.name: git_note
types._comment_agent: A successfully constructed git_note uniquely owns both duplicated signatures and its duplicated message; git_note_free releases all fields then the header.

ptr.note: note_new deep-duplicates the commit signature and git_note_free releases the unique stored signature.
note_new deep-duplicates the commit signature and git_note_free releases the unique stored signature.
note_new duplicates the blob contents into a NUL-terminated allocation and git_note_free releases it; no live-note path mutates the bytes.

types.name: git_object
types._comment_agent: git_object is a refcounted base object. Its cached header owns the reference count; its repository member is a nullable external borrow. The public API keeps the layout opaque.

ptr.note: Borrowed repository pointer set for repository-backed objects and null for objects parsed directly from raw data. The repository must outlive the object; freeing or closing it invalidates the object. Accessors expose a mutable repository pointer.

types.name: git_object_t
types._comment_agent: git_object_t is a fieldless C enum with no ownership or lifetime-bearing members.

types.name: git_odb
types._comment_agent: git_odb is reference-counted through rc. Its only direct pointer field, cgraph, is nullable owned mutable storage replaced and destroyed under the ODB mutex.

ptr.note: The zero-initialized slot exclusively owns one optional git_commit_graph. git_odb_set_commit_graph transfers a replacement into the slot after freeing the old value; git_odb refreshes it through this pointer, and odb_free releases it with git_commit_graph_free.

types.name: git_odb_stream
types._comment_agent: git_odb_stream is a polymorphic base header. It uniquely owns its optional hash context, borrows its originating backend/ODB lifetime, and stores static code callbacks selected by stream mode. The public git_odb_stream_free routine cleans the hash context before invoking the concrete free callback.

ptr.note: The stream borrows the backend selected from its originating ODB; it does not retain or free it. Stream callbacks invoke mutable backend operations, so the ODB/backend owner must outlive the stream.
Static synchronous code callback. It is installed for writable streams and null for read-only streams.
Every fully constructed stream installs a process-code destructor callback. The callback is static and releases the concrete enclosing allocation when invoked by git_odb_stream_free.
The frontend or read-stream implementation allocates this mutable hash context and git_odb_stream_free cleans and frees it. Custom streams may leave it null.
Static synchronous code callback. It is installed for readable streams and null for write-only streams.
Static synchronous code callback. It is installed for writable streams and null for read-only streams.

types.name: git_odb_writepack
types._comment_agent: Observed pack_backend__writepack construction and all field touchers. The callback table is immutable after construction; free dynamically destroys the concrete allocation.

ptr.note: A fully constructed writepack installs a static append function and invokes it synchronously.

A constructed built-in writepack retains its originating ODB backend but never owns it; external backend implementations may leave the public slot null. When present, the owning ODB/backend state must outlive the writepack. No observed writepack path dereferences or writes through this field.
A fully constructed writepack installs a static commit function and invokes it synchronously.
A fully constructed writepack installs a static destructor function; callers invoke it exactly once for owned allocations.

types.name: git_oidarray
types._comment_agent: Observed creation, conversion, reversal, disposal, and public result APIs. ids/count are a coupled owned array header.

ptr.note: The header uniquely owns count contiguous git_oid values allocated by libgit2; null with count zero is the empty state. git_oidarray_dispose frees the run but retains the header.

types.name: git_packbuilder
types._comment_agent: The public API treats git_packbuilder as opaque. Its complete internal pointer-field footprint was inspected to establish the retained repository/callback borrows and owned ODB, name, and object-list storage. Reviewed against pack-objects.c: git__calloc zero-initializes every slot, so odb is absent until git_repository_odb succeeds and git_packbuilder_free guards it, and the two mutex-guarded counters carry their lock binding.

ptr.note: Owned mutable git_pobject allocation grown with git__reallocarray, indexed through nr_objects/nr_alloc, and released by git_packbuilder_free.

git_repository_odb gives the builder an owned reference; pack operations use it and git_packbuilder_free releases that reference with git_odb_free. The git__calloc'd slot stays NULL until that call succeeds, which is why git_packbuilder_free tests it before releasing.
Owned NUL-terminated duplicate created with git__strdup after writing; absent beforehand and released by git_packbuilder_free with git__free.
Optional borrowed function pointer installed by git_packbuilder_set_callbacks; points to static executable code and is never released.
Opaque application callback state retained by git_packbuilder_set_callbacks and passed back unchanged; the callback may mutate it and the application must keep it alive.
Borrowed from git_packbuilder_new's repo argument and retained for the packbuilder lifetime; pack operations call repository APIs through it, while git_packbuilder_free does not release it.

types.name: git_patch
types._comment_agent: git_patch is a refcounted polymorphic base. The public down-reference is git_patch_free; a per-instance static free_fn selects the concrete generated or parsed destructor when the count reaches zero.

ptr.note: Runtime-conditional: parsed patches allocate and free the delta, generated-from-diff patches borrow a delta kept alive by their retained diff, and direct generated patches point into their own derived allocation. Every fully formed public patch has a delta.
Variant destructor selected from static functions. git_patch__free checks for null so partially initialized/zeroed bases are accepted internally.
Owned growable array buffer of git_patch_hunk values; null represents an empty array and the selected patch destructor clears it.
Owned growable array buffer of git_diff_line values; null represents an empty array and the selected patch destructor clears it (parsed variants also free owned line contents).

The patch borrows the optional repository. Generated patch variants retain their backing diff/file-content state, which keeps the repository alive; parsed patches leave this null. git_patch_owner publishes a mutable repository handle.

types.name: git_pathspec
types._comment_agent: git_pathspec owns its optional detached prefix string and is reference counted through rc. git_pathspec_new creates the first count; match lists increment it; git_pathspec_free releases one count.

ptr.note: Optional NUL-terminated common prefix detached from a git_str; git_pathspec__clear releases it with git__free. Consumers only read the stored bytes.

types.name: git_pathspec_match_list
types._comment_agent: A match list owns one reference to its compiled pathspec, its matches pointer-array allocation, its failures array, and its pool. Match elements are borrowed: strings live in the list pool, while diff deltas live in the source diff.

ptr.note: Owned growable allocation of borrowed pointers. String-mode elements point into this list's pool; diff-mode elements point into the source git_diff and require that external object to remain alive.
Owns one refcount acquired by pathspec_match_alloc and released by pathspec_match_free; valid completed match lists always store a non-null pathspec.

types.name: git_push
types._comment_agent: git_push is opaque in the public API and handed to transport callbacks as a borrow. Its internal remote/repository pointers are borrowed; pb is temporary owned state whose stale field value must not be exposed.

ptr.note: Temporary owned packbuilder: initially null, allocated during do_push and consumed by git_packbuilder_free before do_push returns; the field is not cleared and is therefore not a safe post-call borrow surface.
Borrowed from git_push_new's remote argument; the remote owns the push and frees it before freeing itself.
Copied from remote->repo; git_push neither retains nor frees it, and push use is nested within the owning remote and repository lifetimes.

types.name: git_push_update
types._comment_agent: Each push update owns both duplicated refname strings, while the enclosing git_push owns the update allocation and lends const update pointers only during negotiation callbacks.

ptr.note: add_update duplicates the destination refname with git__strdup; git_push_free releases it with git__free. Published negotiation callbacks receive the update only as const and all observed accesses read the NUL-terminated bytes.

add_update duplicates the source refname with git__strdup; git_push_free releases it with git__free. Published negotiation callbacks receive the update only as const and all observed accesses read the NUL-terminated bytes.

types.name: git_rebase
types._comment_agent: The public API keeps git_rebase opaque and uniquely owns each completed handle. Internally it retains a non-owning repository pointer, owns optional index and commit references, three optional duplicated/path strings, and a growable operation array; git_rebase_free releases every owned field and the header.

ptr.note: Optional owned index reference used by in-memory rebases. git_rebase_inmemory_index increments its refcount before lending ownership out, and git_rebase_free releases the rebase's count.
Optional owned git_commit reference used by in-memory rebases. Commit steps replace it after releasing the prior reference, and git_rebase_free releases the final reference.
Optional owned onto name, duplicated or detached during construction and released by git_rebase_free.
Owned growable array of git_rebase_operation values. Null represents an empty array; rebase setup appends and mutates entries, and git_rebase_free clears the backing allocation.
Optional owned original-head name, duplicated or detached during construction and released by git_rebase_free; detached-head rebases leave it null.

Borrowed repository stored by git_rebase_init/open without incrementing ownership. Rebase operations call mutable repository APIs through it and git_rebase_free does not release it, so the repository must outlive the rebase.
Optional owned NUL-terminated state-directory path detached from git_str storage and released by git_rebase_free. It is read but not mutated after installation.

types.name: git_rebase_operation
types._comment_agent: Operations are inline elements of the rebase-owned operations array. exec is an optional borrowed const C string; id is an inline value.

ptr.note: rebase_operation_alloc stores the const input pointer without copying; it is non-null only for EXEC operations and must remain valid with the operation/rebase. Non-EXEC operations carry NULL.

types.name: git_refcount
types._comment_agent: git_refcount embeds the atomic reference-count datum. owner is an optional atomically accessed weak back-reference; it neither transfers ownership nor keeps its referent alive.

ptr.note: Nullable non-owning weak back-reference set and cleared atomically by GIT_REFCOUNT_OWN. The erased pointee varies by embedding type (notably repository or attribute-cache owner), may be used mutably, and is never released by git_refcount.

types.name: git_refdb
types._comment_agent: git_refdb is refcounted via rc. Its public git_refdb_free operation releases one owned count; no public standalone up-ref is exposed.

ptr.note: Optional owned backend. git_refdb_open/new initialize it null or with a fresh backend; git_refdb_set_backend transfers ownership and first frees the prior backend; final refdb destruction calls backend->free.

Borrowed repository back-pointer stored without a refcount increment by git_refdb_new/open; repository ownership and refdb references form a managed enclosing lifetime. Refdb operations use the repository through mutable C APIs.

types.name: git_reference
types._comment_agent: The public API keeps git_reference opaque. Internal pointer ownership follows alloc/dup/free in src/libgit2/refs.c.

ptr.note: Each attached reference owns one refcount on the refdb; git_reference_dup increments it and git_reference_free decrements it. Fresh allocations remain null until attached to a refdb.

A symbolic reference owns a git__strdup allocation freed by git_reference_free. The union storage is null in calloc-initialized direct references; valid symbolic targets are non-null and not mutated in place.

types.name: git_reference_iterator
types._comment_agent: A fully constructed iterator owns one git_refdb reference in db. Its three callbacks are required non-null static function pointers installed by the backend. The public iterator destructor first releases the db reference and then invokes free; next/next_name advance mutable iterator state.

ptr.note: git_refdb_iterator increments this reference before publishing the iterator; git_refdb_iterator_free decrements it before freeing the concrete iterator.
Required backend callback with static code lifetime; it destroys the concrete iterator allocation.
Required backend callback with static code lifetime; invocation advances mutable iterator state and yields an owned reference.
Required backend callback with static code lifetime; invocation advances mutable iterator state and yields a name borrowed from iterator-managed storage until the next advance.

types.name: git_reflog
types._comment_agent: Publicly returned reflogs own ref_name and one refdb count. Internal transaction duplicates are pool-backed, so their ref_name has an alternate borrow from the transaction pool; their null db is never used as an owned refdb count.

ptr.note: A public read installs one incremented git_refdb count, released by git_reflog_free. It is null during backend construction and in transaction pool copies; refcount and backend operations mutate the pointee.
Normally a git__strdup allocation released with the reflog; transaction-only copies instead point into the transaction pool. Null exists during failed or pool-backed construction.

types.name: git_reflog_entry
types._comment_agent: Ordinary entries own their duplicated signature and optional message. Transaction-only duplicates store both allocations in the transaction pool, producing an alternate pool-borrowed representation that is never individually destroyed.

ptr.note: A fully formed ordinary entry owns a duplicated signature; transaction copies borrow a pool duplicate. Null is possible during failed construction, and parsing initializes through this pointer.
Optional owned message in ordinary entries, released by git_reflog_entry__free; transaction copies borrow pool storage. Append normalizes newlines through the allocation.

types.name: git_refspec
types._comment_agent: All three char pointers are independently allocated NUL-terminated strings owned by the refspec and released by git_refspec__dispose. They can be null during initialization, after disposal, and (for dst) in complete negative/fetch refspecs. No code mutates their bytes after storage.

ptr.note: Independent duplicated/detached string allocation; freed by git_refspec__dispose; legitimately null for some complete refspecs as well as partial/disposed values.
Independent git__strndup/git__strdup allocation; freed by git_refspec__dispose; null in zeroed/partially initialized or disposed values.
Independent git__strdup allocation; freed by git_refspec__dispose; null in zeroed/partially initialized or disposed values.

types.name: git_remote
types._comment_agent: Inspected constructors, duplication, setters, connect/upload paths, and git_remote_free across remote.c, fetch.c and push.c.

Optional heap-duplicated push URL; replacement and git_remote_free release it, while callers only read its bytes.
Weak repository pointer copied by git_remote_dup and never released by git_remote_free. Detached remotes store NULL; repository-backed operations may mutate the repository.

types.name: git_remote_autotag_option_t
types._comment_agent: Reviewed against include/git2/remote.h. Closed domain of four contiguous values starting at UNSPECIFIED=0, which GIT_FETCH_OPTIONS_INIT stores and remote.c resolves from the remote's configured autotag setting. Unlike git_remote_redirect_t, the unspecified state is itself a published enumerator, so a wrapper models the field as the plain enum with UNSPECIFIED as its default.

types.name: git_remote_completion_t
types._comment_agent: Reviewed against include/git2/remote.h. Closed domain of three contiguous values from 0; it is only ever an argument to the completion callback in git_remote_callbacks, never a stored options field, so it has no unspecified state and needs no default.

types.name: git_remote_head
types._comment_agent: git_remote_head is a by-value advertised-reference record whose oid fields and local flag are inline. Persistent heads own their allocated name and optional symref_target, while temporary comparison/search heads can borrow name storage; callers receive views owned by the transport or remote rather than an independently disposable head.

ptr.note: Persistent local and smart-transport heads own duplicated name storage, but stack search keys and temporary oid heads borrow another object's name. Formed advertised heads normally have a name; zeroed temporary keys make null observable.
Optional duplicated or detached target string released by the concrete head/packet owner together with the head.

types.name: git_remote_redirect_t
types._comment_agent: Reviewed against include/git2/remote.h and src/libgit2/remote.c. The enumeration publishes exactly three values (NONE=1, INITIAL=2, ALL=4), and http.c switches on a single one rather than testing bits, so it is not a bit set. A follow_redirects field carries a fourth state: GIT_FETCH_OPTIONS_INIT and its siblings leave it 0, and remote.c's lookup_redirect_config reads 0 as unspecified, resolving it from http.followRedirects and falling back to INITIAL when the repository has no such setting or there is no repository. A wrapper must therefore model the field as an optional enum with 0 = unspecified, and must not default it to INITIAL.

types.name: git_repository
types._comment_agent: The public API exposes git_repository only as an opaque, uniquely owned allocation released by git_repository_free. Internally the repository owns one reference to each lazily populated database/config/index pointer, owns all cache and graft allocations, owns its duplicated path/identity strings, and owns the reserved-name array. Every pointer member is nullable during lazy initialization or for repositories without the corresponding path/cache, except reserved_names.ptr, which repository_alloc initializes before publishing a complete repository. Re-reviewed: the nullability of gitdir and commondir is observable through the public getters git_repository_path and git_repository_commondir, both of which return NULL for a repository built by git_repository_new, so their wrappers must be optional.

types.name: git_reset_t
types._comment_agent: Reviewed against include/git2/reset.h and src/libgit2/reset.c. Closed domain of SOFT=1, MIXED=2, HARD=3; git_reset switches on the value and rejects anything else with GIT_ERROR_INVALID, so 0 is not a valid value and the type has no default.

types.name: git_revspec

types.name: git_signature
types._comment_agent: A fully initialized public git_signature owns non-null NUL-terminated name and email allocations. git_signature_free releases both strings and the header; git_signature_dup deep-copies the complete value. Public documentation also permits manual teardown of the three allocations.

ptr.note: Non-null owned NUL-terminated email allocated by libgit2 and released with git__free by git_signature_free.
Non-null owned NUL-terminated name allocated by libgit2 and released with git__free by git_signature_free.

types.name: git_status_list
types._comment_agent: Both diff fields start null, are independently populated according to status show options, and are unconditionally released by the list destructor (git_diff_free accepts null).

ptr.note: Owns one optional git_diff reference produced by git_diff_tree_to_index; git_status_list_free releases it with git_diff_free, and rename analysis may mutate the pointee.
Owns one optional git_diff reference produced by git_diff_index_to_workdir; git_status_list_free releases it with git_diff_free, and rename analysis may mutate the pointee.

types.name: git_strarray
types._comment_agent: git_strarray is a by-value header. Library output owns its counted pointer array and strings and is reset by git_strarray_dispose; input instances commonly borrow stack arrays and string storage and must not be disposed. Borrowed handles therefore only view contents, while owned CVal instances arise empty or from libgit2 output/deep copy.

ptr.note: Counted char-pointer array. Library-produced results own the outer allocation and each non-null NUL-terminated string; caller-supplied input arrays borrow both, so ownership is runtime-conditional. Null outer pointers represent empty arrays (malformed caller inputs may pair null with nonzero count), and git_strarray_copy explicitly tolerates null elements.

types.name: git_submodule
types._comment_agent: git_submodule is an opaque public refcounted handle. Its private layout owns name, url, and branch strings; path is either an alias of name or a distinct owned string. repo is a non-owning pointer to the parent repository, which must remain alive while repository-dependent submodule operations run.

ptr.note: Optional duplicated branch string, initialized NULL and freed by submodule_release.
Owned NUL-terminated name allocated by git__strdup or transferred from parsed config data; released by submodule_release.
Initially aliases name; may later be replaced by a distinct git__strdup allocation. submodule_release frees it only when it differs from name.
Non-owning parent repository pointer copied by submodule_alloc; release clears but never frees it. Repository-dependent operations may mutate through it and require the repository to remain alive.
Optional duplicated URL string; documentation explicitly permits NULL and submodule_release frees it.

types.name: git_tag
types._comment_agent: The public type is opaque. Internal parsing allocates and initializes its three pointer fields; git_tag__free releases each before the tag storage.

ptr.note: Optionally owns a NUL-terminated message allocation; parsing initializes its bytes and git_tag__free releases it.
Owns the mandatory NUL-terminated tag name allocation; parsing initializes its bytes and successful tags always have one.
Optionally owns one heap git_signature, initialized during parsing and released by git_signature_free.

types.name: git_time
types._comment_agent: git_time is a plain by-value timestamp: no pointer fields, no allocation of its own and no lifecycle primitive. The only aggregate that embeds it is git_signature.when, whose lifecycle releases it, so a borrowed handle projected out of the enclosing signature is the whole ownership story. `sign` is NOT a validated discriminator: git_signature__parse memsets the signature, so it stays 0 whenever the parsed buffer carries no timezone field, and src/libgit2/signature.c:389 copies tz_start[0] verbatim after the malformed-timezone branch has already reset offset to 0, so any byte can reach it. git_signature__writebuf reads it loosely, as '-' when the offset is negative or the byte is '-' and '+' otherwise. A Rust accessor must therefore validate the byte rather than transmute it, and treat 0 and stray bytes as ordinary, expected inputs.

types.name: git_transaction
types._comment_agent: The public API keeps transactions opaque. Reference transactions borrow their repository, own one refdb count, and keep lock/pool state inline; config transactions borrow the config and own the type-erased backend-instance count released indirectly by git_config_unlock. The variant discriminator makes the inactive pointer fields null.

ptr.note: Borrowed configuration for the config-transaction variant and passed to git_config_unlock; null for reference transactions.
Type-erased backend_instance count acquired by git_config_lock and consumed through git_config_unlock; null for reference transactions.
Reference transactions own the count returned by git_repository_refdb and release it with git_refdb_free; null for config transactions.
Borrowed repository for the reference-transaction variant; the caller must keep it alive. Null for config transactions.

types.name: git_tree
types._comment_agent: The public type is opaque. Its internal ODB reference and entry array are owned by the tree and released by git_tree__free.

ptr.note: Owns the contiguous tree-entry array governed by entries.size/asize; construction fills and sorts it, and git_array_clear releases it. Empty or unallocated arrays may be null.
Owns one ODB-object reference when parsed from an ODB object; raw-parsed trees leave it null. git_tree__free releases the reference.

types.name: git_tree_entry
types._comment_agent: The public API keeps the layout opaque. filename is always a non-null immutable NUL string. In self-contained duplicated entries it points into trailing storage in the same allocation; tree-owned entries point into storage kept alive by the containing tree, so all published borrows remain bounded by the entry handle's own lifetime.

ptr.note: Borrowed NUL string: trailing self storage for standalone owned entries, or containing-tree storage for tree-owned entries; never freed separately.

It appears only as the action field of a caller-owned git_tree_update descriptor, which git_tree_create_updated reads by value; nothing retains or frees it.

Values outside the two constants are rejected by git_tree_walk rather than reinterpreted, so a Rust wrapper may validate on the way in instead of transmuting.
